description: HTTPS listener support with TLS certificate management and termination.
HTTP to HTTPS redirect for standard security enforcement.
Path-based redirects for URL migration and restructuring.
Host redirect with HTTP status code control (301/302/etc).
Combined port and scheme redirects in a single rule.
Request timeout handling to prevent hung connections.
Backend connection timeout to handle slow backends.
Cross-namespace route attachment with ReferenceGrant for namespace isolation.
Gateway with routes on non-standard ports (8080).
